summary: Satellos Bioscience Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a management information circular and notice of its annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 17, 2026. The circular covers routine matters: receipt of audited financial statements, election of directors, and appointment of auditors. The board recommends voting in favor of each resolution. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or CEO departure is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary AGM notice and proxy circular. As a routine administrative filing, it does not constitute a special-situation event.
